title: Instagram - statistics & facts
description: Instagram users are busy either creating a picture-perfect post or keeping up with celebrities and sports stars. The highly engaging platform keeps users engaged and entertained by offering an endless number of fun filters and 'positive vibes' content. There is however much more than meets the eye with this social media platform - Instagram set the bar for today's booming content creator and influencer industry that many people have successfully forged into a career. With a brand value exceeding 80 billion U.S. dollars in 2026, it's clear there is a lot more to this social network than just a carefully curated window to the world.
